answer: Bind each identity to a hardware attestation key sealed in a device secure element: the enclave signs a fresh challenge and proves genuine firmware, so one device backs only one account. A Sybil attacker cannot mint identities in software; each fake account needs another purchased device and attestation to maintain. Like a comet that cannot be in two skies at once, an enclave signature cannot echo across accounts, and cloning hits the nadir of the scheme: hardware refuses to export the key, so every fake identity costs real hardware.
